security.title: Security
security.lede: Weaknesses agnts found in your repositories: scanners sweep the code, dependencies and secrets, and {agent} judges every hit, finds what they miss and suggests the fix. Fix this turns a finding into an ordinary ticket you approve.
security.postureSub: Open findings and the last scan of each repository.
security.scanBusy: A scan of {repo} is already queued or running.
security.emptyNoScan: This repository has not been scanned yet: run a scan.
security.howScan: Run scan checks the default branch with opengrep (agnts's rules), gitleaks, osv-scanner and trivy, offline, in the sandbox. {agent} then reads the code around every hit, rejects false positives and audits what scanners miss, such as missing ownership checks.
security.howFix: A finding keeps its identity across scans. Fix this opens a ticket that goes through analysis, code, checks and your approval; once it merges, a verify scan checks the finding is gone.
security.fixStarted: {key} opened: agnts is on it. You review the fix before anything is pushed.
security.picked: {n, plural, one {# finding selected} other {# findings selected}}
security.masked: Secret {mask} (masked; agnts never stores the value)
security.statusHelp_reopened: It was fixed, then a scan found it again
security.statusHelp_verifying: The fix merged; a verify scan checks it
security.statusHelp_fixed: The check that found it ran again and no longer sees it
security.statusHelp_dismissed: Someone dismissed it; scans no longer report it
security.dismissSub: It stays dismissed while its fingerprint matches, and scans stop reporting it. Say why, for the next person.
security.reopenedHelp: This was fixed before, and a scan found it again.
security.rotateFirst: Rotate this secret first: removing it from the code does not revoke it, and anyone who cloned the repository has it.
security.suggestedFixSub: Shown for review; agnts applies changes only through a ticket you approve.
security.scansSub: Each scan of the default branch: what ran and what changed. Click one for details.
security.agentHelp_limit: The scanners' results count; findings only {agent} could recheck were left as they were.
security.agentHelp_failed: The scanners' results count; findings only {agent} could recheck were left as they were.
security.rejectedHits: {n, plural, one {# hit rejected as a false positive} other {# hits rejected as false positives}}
security.cardSub: What this ticket fixes. After it merges, a verify scan checks each one.
